intro: Questions that must be answered before a decision can reasonably be made. For each one: what is already known (with a source), what is missing, and how to find it out. Nothing on this page is a recommendation.

items.question: Do the five supplied links credit the selected tracking ID shopnow047c-20?
items.known: None of the five observed redirect URLs contains tag=shopnow047c-20 (FL-04).
items.missing: Associates tracking-report confirmation for each link.
items.how_to_find: Manual: in the logged-in Associates account, generate one Special Link per product, click it once, and compare the tracking report (FL-05).

items.question: Are the supplied link.amazon short links acceptable Special Links?
items.known: The Operating Agreement requires tagged Special Links (section 1). The short-link status is unresolved and is NOT claimed to be invalid.
items.missing: Official confirmation of the short-link status.
items.how_to_find: Test one link in the enrolled Associates workflow; ask Associates support in writing if the result is unclear.

items.question: What ASIN did the submitter intend for each link?
items.known: Observed ASINs: B0CDY277D3, B09B7SB46R, B08DKYBTPH, B0DHZTCNR5, B0DZFD6R9Z.
items.missing: The submitter's intended ASIN for each row.
items.how_to_find: Ask the submitter to confirm each product page; fill the intended ASIN only from that answer and an official listing.

items.question: What do the five products cost today?
items.known: Prices in the fetched text belong to carousel items, not to the five main products.
items.missing: A time-stamped official price per product.
items.how_to_find: Read the price from each listing at publication time and show it only if the Associates price rules allow it (verify Program Policies first).

items.question: How are the five products rated by buyers?
items.known: Carousel ratings exist for other products only.
items.missing: Main-product star rating and review count.
items.how_to_find: Read the rating and count from each listing page on the day of publication; record the date.

items.question: What are the dimensions and weight of each product?
items.known: Only title values are recorded (capacity, probe count, accuracy).
items.missing: Item dimensions and weight from the product details table.
items.how_to_find: Copy them from each listing's product details table and cite that page.

items.question: Which guide topics do real readers search for and click through to?
items.known: Nothing measured. The four working titles are hypotheses, not evidence of search volume.
items.missing: Search queries, landing-page clicks and outbound clicks from this site.
items.how_to_find: Set up Search Console (manual) and enable the analytics endpoint; read real query and click data for 8 to 12 weeks before choosing the next topic.

items.question: What commission would each product earn?
items.known: Not retrieved from an official source.
items.missing: Official commission rate schedule and category rates.
items.how_to_find: Read the Associates commission rate page and the Commission Income Statement, record the date.

items.question: Is the disclosure placed and worded correctly for FTC purposes on every page?
items.known: Amazon wording (section 5) is confirmed. The FTC Disclosures 101 brochure was read (FL-10): disclosures must be hard to miss and placed with the endorsement.
items.missing: FTC guidance read and checked against the site.
items.how_to_find: Reviewer reads the Endorsement Guides and signs off placement on each page (FL-10).

items.question: What is the brand name and who is the named author?
items.known: Working name 'Countertop Check' and byline 'Editorial team' are used.
items.missing: A decision on the brand and any named author.
items.how_to_find: Decide from the suggestion list (see Suggestions S-02, S-03).

items.question: May the site use product photos?
items.known: Program Content includes images, under the Operating Agreement.
items.missing: A decision on which images (Associates-provided only, or none).
items.how_to_find: Decide from Suggestion S-06; check the IP License before using any image.

items.question: Do the external register statuses (S-04 to S-25, D-04 to D-27, F-11 to F-46) match the current site?
items.known: The first part of the Zone4 decision log is reachable (FL-12). It says 'three supplied links' where this brief has five.
items.missing: The rest of the register and the Zone3 register, reconciled line by line.
items.how_to_find: Provide the register contents or a repo path; re-run the review.
